title: No Assistant Psychologist Role? How Job Crafting Can Shape Your Psychology Career

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间换取金钱之外的收入，会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家 Marianne Trent 博士，自 2019 年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性的收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote 的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于 2022 年完成了该项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家完成他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得 Sophie 的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四场小组智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份 Fortnum and Mason 的礼物，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名截止时间为 11 月 16 日星期一晚上 10 点。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时为你解答。

sentences.en: My name's Yana, and I'm a trainee psychological wellbeing practitioner.
sentences.zh: 我叫 Yana，是一名心理健康从业者实习生。

sentences.en: I read the Clinical Psychologist Collective book.
sentences.zh: 我读了《临床心理学家集体》这本书。

sentences.en: I found it really interesting about all the different stories and how people got to become a clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我发现书中关于各种不同的故事以及人们如何成为临床心理学家的内容非常有趣。

sentences.en: It just amazed me how many different routes there are to get there, and there's no perfect way to become one.
sentences.zh: 令我惊讶的是，通往这一目标的途径竟然如此之多，而且并没有所谓的“完美路径”。

sentences.en: And this kind of filled me with confidence that, no, I'm not doing it wrong, and put less pressure on myself.
sentences.zh: 这让我充满信心，意识到我并没有做错，也减轻了我的心理压力。

sentences.en: So if you're feeling a bit uneasy about becoming a clinical psychologist, I'd definitely recommend this, just to put yourself at ease, and everything will be okay.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你对成为临床心理学家感到有些不安，我绝对推荐这本书，它能让你安心，一切都会好起来的。

sentences.en: What if the key to your psychology career isn't about ticking all the usual boxes, but rewriting the script entirely?
sentences.zh: 如果心理学职业生涯的关键不在于按部就班地完成所有常规要求，而是彻底改写剧本呢？

sentences.en: In today's episode, I'm joined by Jack Lowe, who shares how he carved out a meaningful psychology path without ever landing an assistant psychologist role.
sentences.zh: 在今天的节目中，Jack Lowe 加入了我们，他分享了自己如何在从未担任过助理心理学家角色的情况下，开辟出一条有意义的心理学道路。

sentences.en: From setbacks to speaking gigs, this one is for anyone wondering if there's still a way in for them, even if it doesn't look like the traditional route.
sentences.zh: 从挫折到演讲机会，这一集献给所有想知道自己是否还有机会进入该领域的人，即使这看起来并不像传统的路径。

sentences.en: Hope you find it super useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得它非常有用。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎来到《有抱负的心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent, a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是 Marianne Trent 博士，一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: Now, I did take quite a traditional route, but I do feel like I've been able to be reflective and curious and make the most of roles that haven't seemed that relevant at the time.
sentences.zh: 我确实走了一条相当传统的路线，但我感觉自己能够保持反思和好奇，并充分利用那些当时看起来并不相关的角色。

sentences.en: And that is something that I am speaking with Jack about today, who is an expert in this.
sentences.zh: 这也是我今天与 Jack 讨论的话题，他在这方面是专家。

sentences.en: And we've got lots of interesting theory, concepts, kind of models, ways of working.
sentences.zh: 我们有很多有趣的理论、概念、模型和工作方式。

sentences.en: And this is a really lovely episode.
sentences.zh: 这是一期非常棒的节目。

sentences.en: Hope you find it really useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得它真的很有用。

sentences.en: I'll catch you on the other side.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后见。

sentences.en: Hi, I just want to welcome along our guest for today, Jack Lowe.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我想欢迎我们今天的嘉宾 Jack Lowe。

sentences.en: Hi, Jack.
sentences.zh: 嗨，Jack。

sentences.en: Welcome along.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到这里。

sentences.en: Hi, it's great to be here today.
sentences.zh: 嗨，很高兴今天能来到这里。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: Thank you for being here.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你的到来。

sentences.en: And thank you for pitching the episode to me, because actually, I really love it when people come up with kind of diverse angles for talking about psychology and, you know,
sentences.zh: 也谢谢你向我推荐这一集，因为我真的很喜欢人们提出各种不同的角度来谈论心理学，你知道，

sentences.en: their passion and why it matters to them.
sentences.zh: 他们的热情以及为什么这对他们很重要。

sentences.en: So, yeah, tell us a bit about what people might get from today, please, Jack.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，请告诉我们大家今天能从中学到什么，Jack。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think from today, I really want to kind of try and frame my experience.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想今天我真的想尝试梳理一下我的经验。

sentences.en: I've only recently discovered I'm quite an unconventional, untraditional student.
sentences.zh: 我最近才发现自己是一个非常规、非传统的学生。

sentences.en: And my career has definitely followed that as well, working very entry-level roles to customer service.
sentences.zh: 我的职业生涯也确实遵循了这一点，从事着非常入门级的客户服务工作。

sentences.en: And I've really had to get creative with how I can make the most out of these roles to make them psychologically informed to kind of get to where I am now.
sentences.zh: 我确实必须发挥创造力，充分利用这些角色，使它们具有心理学意义，从而达到我现在的水平。

sentences.en: I'm lucky to work for a large mental health charity.
sentences.zh: 我很幸运能为一家大型心理健康慈善机构工作。

sentences.en: I'm lucky to work as a regional manager with that.
sentences.zh: 我很幸运能担任该机构的区域经理。

sentences.en: I'm also now doing a master's, but it's not always been a straightforward start.
sentences.zh: 我现在也在读硕士，但起步并不总是那么顺利。

sentences.en: There's been a lot of redos, some failings, and having to really learn from that, which I really want to try and promote today for, you know,
sentences.zh: 经历了很多重来、一些失败，并不得不真正从中学习，我今天真的很想尝试为，你知道，

sentences.en: students and other aspiring psychologists.
sentences.zh: 学生和其他有抱负的心理学家推广这一点。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: So now we know what we're going to get.
sentences.zh: 既然我们知道我们要得到什么了。

sentences.en: Let's have a little bit of an overview about who we're going to get it from.
sentences.zh: 让我们简单了解一下我们将从谁那里得到这些信息。

sentences.en: So tell us a bit about yourself, Jack.
sentences.zh: 那么，Jack，请简单介绍一下你自己。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 好的，没问题。

sentences.en: So my name is Jack Lowe.
sentences.zh: 我叫 Jack Lowe。

sentences.en: I'm born and based in Blackpool.
sentences.zh: 我在布莱克浦出生并定居。

sentences.en: I did, I think some of my takeaways is that I've kind of done university after like three false attempts.
sentences.zh: 我想我的一些收获是，我在经历了三次失败的尝试后才上了大学。

sentences.en: I've had a failing, I've had a dropout, I've had a deferred, similar with sixth form as well.
sentences.zh: 我经历过失败、辍学、延期，高中时也是如此。

sentences.en: So my relationship with education was always a little bit complex.
sentences.zh: 所以我与教育的关系一直有点复杂。

sentences.en: And then I've kind of returned as an adult learner.
sentences.zh: 后来我以成年学习者的身份回归了。

sentences.en: Same with building my career.
sentences.zh: 建立职业生涯也是一样。

sentences.en: So for the longest part, I started off in telesales and then kind of went into customer service.
sentences.zh: 很长一段时间里，我从电话销售开始，然后进入了客户服务领域。

sentences.en: It was all these kind of entry-level roles.
sentences.zh: 这些都是入门级的角色。

sentences.en: And I just got to a point where I thought, I need to get a little bit more serious about developing my career.
sentences.zh: 我到了一个阶段，心想，我需要更认真地对待我的职业发展。

sentences.en: But I also have bills to pay.
sentences.zh: 但我也有账单要付。

sentences.en: I need to do what I need to do now.
sentences.zh: 我需要做我现在必须做的事情。

sentences.en: So what can I do to really make the most of that?
sentences.zh: 那么我能做些什么来真正充分利用它呢？

sentences.en: And now as I'm doing my master's, you know, I've got a definition for that.
sentences.zh: 现在我正在读硕士，你知道，我对此有一个定义。

sentences.en: I've got a term for it that we talk about around job crafting.
sentences.zh: 我有一个术语，我们称之为“工作塑造”（job crafting）。

sentences.en: So what we can do to make that role, you know, fulfilling for us and get us to our long-term goals.
sentences.zh: 即我们可以做些什么来让那个角色对我们来说是有成就感的，并引导我们实现长期目标。

sentences.en: So really get a bit creative with it.
sentences.zh: 所以真的要发挥一点创造力。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Tell us a bit more about job crafting then.
sentences.zh: 那么请多介绍一下“工作塑造”。

sentences.en: So job crafting is the term.
sentences.zh: “工作塑造”就是这个术语。

sentences.en: It can be done across different ways.
sentences.zh: 它可以通过不同的方式实现。

sentences.en: There's a few little breakdowns from it, whether it's cognitive crafting, so the way we think about our role.
sentences.zh: 它有几个细分，比如认知塑造，即我们思考角色的方式。

sentences.en: Very similar for those that are looking more at maybe mental health or clinical psychology around that kind of CBT.
sentences.zh: 对于那些更多关注心理健康或临床心理学的人来说，这与 CBT（认知行为疗法）非常相似。

sentences.en: What are my thought patterns around this?
sentences.zh: 我对此的想法模式是什么？

sentences.en: And I know there's been several studies around people assessing their kind of well-being, their mood and job satisfaction based on how they think about their role.
sentences.zh: 我知道已经有几项研究是关于人们如何根据他们对角色的看法来评估他们的幸福感、情绪和工作满意度的。

sentences.en: Whether they view it positively, whether they view it negatively or whether they view it as being important.
sentences.zh: 无论他们是积极地看待它，消极地看待它，还是认为它很重要。

sentences.en: So whether you're someone that is just cleaning the floors or keeping this hospital safe and sanitary to benefit people and having that kind of difference in thinking pattern has a massive effect.
sentences.zh: 所以，无论你只是一个清洁工，还是为了造福他人而保持医院的安全和卫生，这种思维模式的差异会产生巨大的影响。

sentences.en: But then also the more practical kind of task crafting.
sentences.zh: 但还有更实际的“任务塑造”。

sentences.en: So what kind of task do I do in my day-to-day?
sentences.zh: 我在日常工作中做些什么任务？

sentences.en: What is it in my job description?
sentences.zh: 我的职位描述里有什么？

sentences.en: And what is it I actually want to do that I'm passionate about, that fulfills me, that challenges me?
sentences.zh: 我真正想做的是什么，我热衷于什么，什么能满足我，什么能挑战我？

sentences.en: And I definitely think that's something I've been doing without knowing the term over the last couple of years to really bring psychology to a role,
sentences.zh: 我绝对认为这是我过去几年在不知道这个术语的情况下一直在做的事情，为了真正将心理学带入一个角色，

sentences.en: even though it's not a traditional psychology role like an AP.
sentences.zh: 即使它不是像助理心理学家那样的传统心理学角色。

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: And I think that's something that really resonates with me.
sentences.zh: 我认为这确实引起了我的共鸣。

sentences.en: Actually, one of my very early podcast episodes is about making the most of kind of non-psychology roles to still strengthen and advance your career.
sentences.zh: 实际上，我非常早期的播客剧集之一就是关于如何充分利用非心理学角色来加强和推进你的职业生涯。

sentences.en: And I think that's probably because of its age, it's one of the most downloaded episodes as well.
sentences.zh: 我想这可能是因为它的时间比较久，它也是下载量最高的剧集之一。

sentences.en: But because it does matter, you know, what we learn along the journey does matter.
sentences.zh: 但因为它确实很重要，你知道，我们在旅途中学到的东西确实很重要。

sentences.en: And I wonder whether the concept of job crafting that perhaps you and I have been doing before knowing what it was called, maybe helps us to maybe not burn out as well.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，你和我可能在不知道它叫什么之前就已经在做的“工作塑造”概念，是否也有助于我们避免职业倦怠。

sentences.en: Because it feels like you've got your own little sort of mission, your own kind of purpose.
sentences.zh: 因为它感觉你有自己的小使命，有自己的目标。

sentences.en: But I guess once you feel like you've reached saturation point, you might then risk bore out.
sentences.zh: 但我猜一旦你觉得达到了饱和点，你可能会面临“无聊倦怠”的风险。

sentences.en: And it's then that you've kind of you've reached the limit of what you can gain from that.
sentences.zh: 那时你就达到了你能从中获得的极限。

sentences.en: And maybe that's an indication that it's time to move on.
sentences.zh: 也许这表明是时候继续前进了。

sentences.en: A hundred percent.
sentences.zh: 百分之百。

sentences.en: And I think it would be down to the individual, what their core job is and maybe how far they can push over the boundaries.
sentences.zh: 我认为这取决于个人，他们的核心工作是什么，以及他们能在多大程度上突破界限。

sentences.en: I know in some of my, I say more entry level positions or in call centres that you are very restricted to what you can do.
sentences.zh: 我知道在我的一些入门级职位或呼叫中心，你对能做的事情受到很大限制。

sentences.en: So you do have to be a little bit creative to market either additional duties.
sentences.zh: 所以你确实必须发挥一点创造力来推销额外的职责。

sentences.en: And but even things where there's sometimes a little bit of a sacrifice to get what you may need.
sentences.zh: 即使有时为了得到你可能需要的东西而做出一点牺牲。

sentences.en: So I know in the past, I've done volunteering work as well as an additional to my hours to fulfill those needs that I wanted.
sentences.zh: 我知道过去我做过志愿者工作，作为我工作时间的补充，以满足我想要的需求。

sentences.en: Alongside that, I've also volunteered with the BPS and sat on their committee.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，我还曾在英国心理学会（BPS）做志愿者，并担任其委员会成员。

sentences.en: So again, to build experience and interest and have a little play around with what do I actually enjoy doing?
sentences.zh: 所以，再次强调，为了建立经验和兴趣，并尝试一下我真正喜欢做什么？

sentences.en: Do I enjoy writing content?
sentences.zh: 我喜欢写内容吗？

sentences.en: Do I enjoy supporting people directly?
sentences.zh: 我喜欢直接支持他人吗？

sentences.en: And have a little play around with it rather than just focusing on the kind of end destination of a particular job role?
sentences.zh: 尝试一下，而不是仅仅关注某个特定职位的最终目的地。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: And I know I've worked in call centre as well before and thinking about actually the skills that we've got perhaps as a result of doing our undergrad.
sentences.zh: 我知道我以前也在呼叫中心工作过，思考一下我们作为本科学习的结果所拥有的技能。

sentences.en: That actually might mean that we are an asset to the service as well, that we can kind of get involved with thinking about data,
sentences.zh: 这实际上可能意味着我们也是该服务的资产，我们可以参与思考数据，

sentences.en: thinking about some of the kind of people management and the way that people work really well together and kind of productivity and proactivity as kind of Dr. Joe Gray was telling us about recently.
sentences.zh: 思考一些人员管理以及人们如何很好地协同工作，以及生产力和主动性，正如 Joe Gray 博士最近告诉我们的那样。

sentences.en: And yeah, for me, I found I was getting permission to do a little bit less of the work I was paid for and a little bit more of kind of cultivating the relationship with my manager
sentences.zh: 是的，对我来说，我发现我获得了许可，可以少做一点我拿薪水的工作，多做一点培养与经理关系的工作，

sentences.en: to do other jobs that support the functioning of the team, but also then reduce the pressure for me having to answer the calls relentlessly all day.
sentences.zh: 去做其他支持团队运作的工作，同时也减轻了我整天不停接听电话的压力。
百分之百。

sentences.en: I know in the last two call centres I worked in, the way I did it was through mental health first aiders.
sentences.zh: 我知道在我工作的最后两个呼叫中心，我这样做是通过心理健康急救员的方式。

sentences.en: So in one of the call centres, I was customer service.
sentences.zh: 在其中一个呼叫中心，我负责客户服务。

sentences.en: We were taking calls from people.
sentences.zh: 我们接听人们的电话。

sentences.en: We were actually overseeing their payroll.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上是在监督他们的工资单。

sentences.en: So we'd get people angry if there was an issue with their wages, if the people hadn't sent over a timesheet and we were processing a payment.
sentences.zh: 如果他们的工资有问题，或者如果人们没有发送时间表而我们正在处理付款，人们会很生气。

sentences.en: You know, they've got a weekend, they've got bills, they've got family.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们有周末，有账单，有家庭。

sentences.en: We'd get them in, you know, really high emotional states.
sentences.zh: 我们让他们处于非常高的情绪状态。

sentences.en: And all times that we'd have people going off work for sickness, struggling with their mental health, workplace bullying, whatever it may be.
sentences.zh: 而且我们总会遇到人们因病请假、心理健康挣扎、职场欺凌等各种情况。

sentences.en: So that's where I kind of saw an opportunity and said, well, actually, I'd like to be a mental health first aider.
sentences.zh: 所以我看到了一个机会，说，好吧，实际上，我想成为一名心理健康急救员。

sentences.en: We had them in the company already, but they typically were kind of our HR accountants and not people customer facing.
sentences.zh: 公司里已经有这样的人了，但他们通常是人力资源会计，而不是面对客户的人。

sentences.en: So I said, this is why it'll be a benefit.
sentences.zh: 所以我说，这就是为什么它会有好处。

sentences.en: We all struggle with these calls.
sentences.zh: 我们都在这些电话中挣扎。

sentences.en: It gives me a skill.
sentences.zh: 它给了我一项技能。

sentences.en: It's something I'm passionate in.
sentences.zh: 这是我热衷的事情。

sentences.en: It's a, you know, a bit of a no brainer.
sentences.zh: 这是一个显而易见的选择。

sentences.en: It suits everyone.
sentences.zh: 它适合每个人。

sentences.en: So that was what I did.
sentences.zh: 这就是我所做的。

sentences.en: And I really enjoyed that because it allowed me to use different skills that were still relevant.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢它，因为它让我使用了仍然相关的不同技能。

sentences.en: So if I wanted to continue going into a P role or a PWP, it's that experience of talking to people, you know, in an emotional state, in a crisis, trying to support them, sound,
sentences.zh: 所以如果我想继续从事助理心理学家或心理健康从业者（PWP）的角色，这就是在情绪化、危机状态下与人交谈的经验，试图支持他们，提供建议，

sentences.en: post, you know, empathetic and active listening and utilising those skills in quite an untraditional context.
sentences.zh: 表现出同理心和积极倾听，并在相当非传统的背景下利用这些技能。

sentences.en: And the last contact centre I worked in, we didn't have any mental health first aiders in the call centre.
sentences.zh: 在我工作的最后一个联络中心，呼叫中心里没有任何心理健康急救员。

sentences.en: We had a bit of a divide because it was two buildings.
sentences.zh: 我们有一点隔阂，因为那是两栋楼。

sentences.en: So you had one building call centre.
sentences.zh: 一栋楼是呼叫中心。

sentences.en: Then you had the other building that was all the finance, L&D, HR.
sentences.zh: 另一栋楼是财务、学习与发展（L&D）和人力资源部门。

sentences.en: So we were a little bit left alone.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有点被孤立了。

sentences.en: And I said, well, nobody wants to speak to the head of HR.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，没人想和人力资源主管说话。

sentences.en: Let me, again, become a mental health first aider.
sentences.zh: 让我再次成为一名心理健康急救员。

sentences.en: Do it as part of your network.
sentences.zh: 把它作为你网络的一部分。

sentences.en: And then there's someone on the ground.
sentences.zh: 然后现场就有人了。

sentences.en: And I was really popular as a mental health first aider.
sentences.zh: 作为心理健康急救员，我真的很受欢迎。

sentences.en: And it saddens me to think these people may not have reached out to support across the road in the other building.
sentences.zh: 想到这些人可能没有向马路对面另一栋楼寻求支持，我感到很难过。

sentences.en: And so for anyone listening today, I would have definitely encouraged that if you are wanting to work more with mental health, the more clinical or counselling psychology side,
sentences.zh: 所以对于今天收听的任何人，如果你们想更多地从事心理健康、临床或咨询心理学方面的工作，我绝对会鼓励这样做，

sentences.en: that's a good way you can get some experience in a non-traditional role.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的方式，让你在非传统角色中获得一些经验。

sentences.en: In your corporate role, if you are still working, you know, in call centres or in hospitality or whatever it may be,
sentences.zh: 在你的企业角色中，如果你仍然在呼叫中心或酒店业等领域工作，

sentences.en: that's a really good way you can try and gain some of those skills and experiences.
sentences.zh: 这是一个尝试获得这些技能和经验的非常好的方法。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: And if you can get it kind of done within your job role where you're already salaried or you're already earning money,
sentences.zh: 如果你能在现有的薪资岗位职责范围内完成这些工作，

sentences.en: then that's even more equitable for you and for others accessing the career as well.
sentences.zh: 那么这对你以及其他进入这一职业领域的人来说，会更加公平。

sentences.en: Because obviously voluntary and honorary work, there's a whole heap of ethical considerations.
sentences.zh: 因为显然，志愿服务和荣誉性质的工作涉及大量的伦理考量。

sentences.en: But if we can kind of build that in and then get the skills, even when we're doing kind of on paper unrelated work,
sentences.zh: 但如果我们能将其融入其中并获得技能，即使我们做的是纸面上看起来不相关的工作，

sentences.en: we're able to actually evidence these key kind of clinical groups that we've worked with, even outside of clinical settings.
sentences.zh: 我们也能够真正证明我们与这些关键临床群体合作过，即使是在临床环境之外。

sentences.en: So, of course, if someone is looking to kind of think about coming into clinical psychology,
sentences.zh: 所以，当然，如果有人在考虑进入临床心理学领域，

sentences.en: the four core groups we'll often look at are children, young people and families, working age adults, older adults and people with intellectual disabilities.
sentences.zh: 我们通常关注的四个核心群体是：儿童、青少年及家庭，工作年龄的成年人，老年人，以及智力障碍人士。

sentences.en: So, if you're able to kind of almost become like a core champion in the work you're doing already for one of those areas.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你能在你现有的工作中，几乎成为其中某个领域的“核心拥护者”。

sentences.en: So, I know, for example,
sentences.zh: 比如我知道，

sentences.en: one of my friends who's not an aspiring psych but works in a medical surgery really enjoys and has previously worked with people with intellectual disabilities.
sentences.zh: 我的一位朋友，她不是心理学专业的学生，但在一家医疗诊所工作，她非常喜欢与智力障碍人士共事，而且之前也有过相关经验。

sentences.en: And so, actually, she's now almost a champion for doing things within her work role to really support people with intellectual disabilities.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，她现在几乎成了在工作中支持智力障碍人士的带头人。

sentences.en: And that's a really nice example of kind of job crafting that whatever you're doing, is there a champion?
sentences.zh: 这是一个关于“工作重塑”的绝佳例子：无论你在做什么，是否能成为某个领域的带头人？

sentences.en: Could you be it?
sentences.zh: 你能成为那个人吗？

sentences.en: You know, to help service run better, which will help the clients accessing the service.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这有助于改善服务运行，从而帮助到使用该服务的客户。

sentences.en: It potentially helps upskill other people in the service as well, but helps you to evidence that you've got real skills in this area.
sentences.zh: 这可能还有助于提升服务中其他人的技能，同时也能帮助你证明自己在这一领域拥有真正的能力。

sentences.en: And to potentially identify future training, you might need to support that.
sentences.zh: 并可能为你确定未来需要什么样的培训来支持这一目标。

sentences.en: And, you know, before you know it, you're building those blocks on your way.
sentences.zh: 而且，不知不觉中，你就已经在为自己的职业道路打下基石了。

sentences.en: A hundred percent, and it's definitely something I've been lucky to kind of grasp some of the opportunities off.
sentences.zh: 百分之百，这绝对是我有幸抓住机会去做的事情。

sentences.en: It's been my current role.
sentences.zh: 这就在我目前的工作中。

sentences.en: I'm part of a well-being network.
sentences.zh: 我是幸福感网络的一员。

sentences.en: So, I've been running workshops.
sentences.zh: 所以我一直在举办研讨会。

sentences.en: I've been applying psychological theory.
sentences.zh: 我一直在应用心理学理论。

sentences.en: I was doing the hero model for developing psychological capital for how people can prevent burnout and curse themselves.
sentences.zh: 我当时在用“英雄模型”（HERO model）来培养心理资本，帮助人们预防倦怠并进行自我疗愈。

sentences.en: But, again, that's very untraditional.
sentences.zh: 但同样，这非常不传统。

sentences.en: It's not necessarily part of my job role, but it's something a lot of organisations will have, both in public and private sector,
sentences.zh: 它不一定是我职位描述的一部分，但很多组织，无论是公共部门还是私营部门，都会有这样的角色，

sentences.en: of champion roles and mental health first aiders, things around well-being or diversity and inclusion.
sentences.zh: 比如拥护者角色、心理健康急救员，以及围绕幸福感或多元化与包容性的事务。

sentences.en: And especially in charities as well, a lot of the co-production groups as well.
sentences.zh: 特别是在慈善机构中，也有很多共同生产小组。

sentences.en: So, again, all hands-on experience with people directly going for, you know, a common goal, an achievement.
sentences.zh: 所以，这同样是与人们直接为了共同目标和成就而努力的实践经验。

sentences.en: There's an objective there.
sentences.zh: 那里有一个明确的目标。

sentences.en: And then you can also apply your theory to that as well.
sentences.zh: 然后你也可以将你的理论应用到其中。

sentences.en: Hmm, fabulous.
sentences.zh: 嗯，太棒了。

sentences.en: I don't think we've spoken about the hero model on the podcast before.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们之前在播客里还没聊过“英雄模型”。

sentences.en: Are you able to tell us a little bit more about that, Jack?
sentences.zh: Jack，你能多给我们讲讲这个吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: So, I really enjoy the hero model.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢英雄模型。

sentences.en: I think partially because it's got a very nice, catchy title.
sentences.zh: 我想部分原因是因为它有一个非常动听、朗朗上口的标题。

sentences.en: I know in my workshop I phrased it quite cringey, but I'm all here for a little bit of cheese of be your own hero.
sentences.zh: 我知道在我的研讨会上，我表达得有点肉麻，但我完全支持这种“做自己的英雄”的小小鸡汤。

sentences.en: And then I talked about the hero model.
sentences.zh: 然后我就讲了英雄模型。

sentences.en: So, it was a wonderful segment for me.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，这是一个很棒的环节。

sentences.en: It was done by, I think it was, Lufthansa et al, I think 2006.
sentences.zh: 它是，我想应该是 Luthans 等人在 2006 年提出的。

sentences.en: And it is all around psychological capital.
sentences.zh: 它完全围绕着心理资本。

sentences.en: So, the resources we have as an individual to make sure we're kind of resilient, we've got positive well-being.
sentences.zh: 也就是我们作为个体所拥有的资源，以确保我们具有韧性，并拥有积极的幸福感。

sentences.en: And there's been loads of studies around it, especially in the workplace, on preventing burnout, job satisfaction, life satisfaction.
sentences.zh: 围绕它已经有很多研究了，特别是在工作场所，关于预防倦怠、工作满意度和生活满意度方面。

sentences.en: And the hero stands for things that we can do to build hope, self-efficacy, resilience and optimism.
sentences.zh: 而 HERO 代表了我们可以用来建立希望（Hope）、自我效能（Self-efficacy）、韧性（Resilience）和乐观（Optimism）的事物。

sentences.en: So, a lot of things that we can do, and I bring it into the workplace of what we can do as an individual, and what we can do, you know, systematically across the organisation,
sentences.zh: 所以，有很多我们可以做的事情，我把它带入工作场所，关于我们作为个体能做什么，以及我们如何在整个组织中系统地去做，

sentences.en: working towards these kind of principles.
sentences.zh: 朝着这些原则努力。

sentences.en: So, things we can do for hope, things around kind of goal setting.
sentences.zh: 关于希望，我们可以做一些目标设定的事情。

sentences.en: So, having a goal in mind to keep us hopeful and also that sense of achievement.
sentences.zh: 所以，心中有一个目标能让我们保持希望，也能带来成就感。

sentences.en: Self-efficacy is rooted in how confident we are in our abilities.
sentences.zh: 自我效能感植根于我们对自己能力的自信程度。

sentences.en: So, I try and promote that as individuals around that training, you know, what is it to make you feel confident in what you do.
sentences.zh: 所以我尝试在培训中促进这一点，你知道，是什么让你对自己的工作感到自信。

sentences.en: That kind of bleeds quite nicely into that resilience.
sentences.zh: 这会很好地延伸到韧性上。

sentences.en: So, whether we're looking at things in a kind of problem-focused orientation or solution-focused.
sentences.zh: 所以，无论我们是以问题为导向还是以解决方案为导向来看待事物。

sentences.en: And if we've got the correct kind of training with that, we might be able to make better judgements and we can workshop scenarios.
sentences.zh: 如果我们有正确的培训，我们或许能做出更好的判断，并且可以进行情景演练。

sentences.en: And then, optimism, I tend to do that a bit more on the kind of CBT-based of things.
sentences.zh: 然后是乐观，我倾向于在 CBT（认知行为疗法）的基础上多做一点。

sentences.en: So, let's challenge some of those negative thoughts that we have, whether it's a case of 10 people keep emailing me for help and I'm getting frustrated.
sentences.zh: 所以，让我们挑战那些负面想法，比如有 10 个人一直发邮件向我求助，我感到很沮丧。

sentences.en: Can we reframe that to something that's a more helpful and healthy thought of?
sentences.zh: 我们能否将其重构为一个更有帮助、更健康的念头？

sentences.en: I'm the go-to person when people need support.
sentences.zh: “我是人们需要支持时的首选联系人。”

sentences.en: And those little four things can really contribute to a much more kind of positive day-to-day working sense of self.
sentences.zh: 这四个小点真的能让你每天的工作状态变得更加积极。

sentences.en: And that's the hero model in a bit of a nutshell.
sentences.zh: 这就是英雄模型的简要概述。

sentences.en: I love it.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: I love this podcast as well.
sentences.zh: 我也很喜欢这个播客。

sentences.en: How incredible to be able to kind of talk people through this.
sentences.zh: 能向大家讲解这些真是太不可思议了。

sentences.en: And I guess as you were talking, I was thinking about the optimism and I was thinking about when we're kind of in an education system,
sentences.zh: 我想在你说话的时候，我在思考乐观，也在思考当我们处于教育体系中时，

sentences.en: we kind of get used to thinking about what our level of capability is.
sentences.zh: 我们习惯于思考我们的能力水平。

sentences.en: And sometimes we find ourselves in situations where actually we feel like we're falling short of where we would usually expect ourselves to be.
sentences.zh: 有时我们发现自己处于这样一种境地：实际上我们感觉自己没有达到我们通常期望的水平。

sentences.en: And I know this is something we spoke about before we hit record, that that's something I experienced probably both in A-levels and in my undergrad as well.
sentences.zh: 我知道这是我们在录音前聊过的话题，我在 A-level 和本科阶段可能都经历过这种情况。

sentences.en: And I wish I'd known that actually it's okay to ask for help.
sentences.zh: 我真希望当时就知道，其实寻求帮助是没问题的。

sentences.en: And actually, if you feel like you're not living up to your full potential, you know, where you typically see yourself or what you see yourself as being capable of,
sentences.zh: 实际上，如果你觉得没有发挥出全部潜力，你知道，没有达到你通常认为自己能达到的水平，

sentences.en: please do get yourself to the Centre for Academic Writing.
sentences.zh: 请务必去学术写作中心（Centre for Academic Writing）。

sentences.en: Please do reach out to your tutor.
sentences.zh: 请务必联系你的导师。

sentences.en: Please do reach out and ask for more specific guidance about how you can meet the criteria that you are being judged againSt.
sentences.zh: 请务必伸出援手，询问关于如何达到你被评估标准的更具体指导。

sentences.en: What would you say about that, Jack?
sentences.zh: Jack，你对此怎么看？

sentences.en: A hundred percent.
sentences.zh: 百分之百同意。

sentences.en: It's something I've realised.
sentences.zh: 这是我后来才意识到的。

sentences.en: I wish I'd realised it sooner.
sentences.zh: 我真希望我能早点意识到。

sentences.en: I've done two undergrads with the Open University and I'm now doing my Master's at Birkbeck.
sentences.zh: 我在英国开放大学（Open University）读了两个本科，现在正在伯克贝克学院（Birkbeck）读硕士。

sentences.en: My approach at Birkbeck has been very different in terms of I am reaching out for help and I'm making the most out of opportunities.
sentences.zh: 我在伯克贝克学院的方法非常不同，因为我会主动寻求帮助，并充分利用各种机会。

sentences.en: So whether they do Q&As around the assessments, my mind frame now is going to this is not going to hurt me.
sentences.zh: 所以无论他们是否举办关于评估的问答环节，我现在的心态是：这又不会伤害我。

sentences.en: It is only going to possibly help.
sentences.zh: 它只会可能有帮助。

sentences.en: So whereas before when I was a little bit younger or doing it with the Open University, I think it's okay, I've got the brief.
sentences.zh: 而在我年轻一点，或者在开放大学读书时，我想的是“好吧，我有任务简报了”。

sentences.en: Whereas now, as Joe Gray would say, I'm proactive in my approach.
sentences.zh: 而现在，正如 Joe Gray 所说，我在方法上是主动的。

sentences.en: I'm the one instigating help because tutors and colleges typically won't reach out.
sentences.zh: 我是那个主动寻求帮助的人，因为导师和学院通常不会主动找你。

sentences.en: It's up to me to speak up if I want that support.
sentences.zh: 如果我想要支持，就得靠我自己说出来。

sentences.en: It's something I encourage as well in work because I work with a lot of people, all aspiring psychologists, people in first year students.
sentences.zh: 这也是我在工作中鼓励的事情，因为我和很多人一起工作，他们都是有抱负的心理学家，或者是大一学生。

sentences.en: I'll say anything you want to discuss, feel free to send me an email.
sentences.zh: 我会说，任何你想讨论的事情，随时给我发邮件。

sentences.en: I'm more than happy to help, signpost, recommend podcasts, you know, whatever it may be.
sentences.zh: 我很乐意提供帮助、指引方向、推荐播客，你知道，无论是什么。

sentences.en: I've got my years of knowledge and experience that I want to share.
sentences.zh: 我有我多年的知识和经验，我想分享出来。

sentences.en: And there are people, you know, in colleges, in schools, in universities who are passionate about helping students.
sentences.zh: 而且在学院、学校、大学里，确实有人热衷于帮助学生。

sentences.en: You just need to say, hi, I'm one of the students that need help.
sentences.zh: 你只需要说：嗨，我是需要帮助的学生之一。

sentences.en: And they'll always be happy to.
sentences.zh: 他们总是会很乐意帮忙的。

sentences.en: Please keep saying that and please keep de-shaming that process because actually I needed to hear that more than once.
sentences.zh: 请继续这样说，请继续消除这个过程中的羞耻感，因为实际上我需要不止一次听到这些话。

sentences.en: And I probably only heard that maybe once at the start of my degree when I was 18.
sentences.zh: 我可能在 18 岁刚开始读学位时只听到过一次。

sentences.en: And actually I was 18, 19 and 20.
sentences.zh: 实际上我当时 18、19 和 20 岁。

sentences.en: I was a young one.
sentences.zh: 我当时还很年轻。

sentences.en: So I didn't turn 21 until I'd almost, I'd finished already, basically, because I'm a June baby.
sentences.zh: 因为我是 6 月出生的，所以我快读完时才满 21 岁。

sentences.en: And I never once, I would say, sat on the front row of a lecture.
sentences.zh: 我可以说，我从来没有坐在讲座的第一排。

sentences.en: It did tend to be the mature students, those that were 21 and above.
sentences.zh: 那通常是成熟学生（大龄学生）坐的地方，那些 21 岁及以上的人。

sentences.en: But those mature students accessed and interacted with their education in a different way.
sentences.zh: 但那些成熟学生以不同的方式获取和参与他们的教育。

sentences.en: And I always would have been like, if I'd been able to apply myself in the way that they had, I would have done much better.
sentences.zh: 我总是想，如果我能像他们那样投入，我会做得更好。

sentences.en: And there's no, you know, I think I almost got away from my roots, actually.
sentences.zh: 而且没有，你知道，我觉得我几乎偏离了我的初衷，真的。

sentences.en: Because when I was in year seven, year eight and nine, I loved learning.
sentences.zh: 因为在七年级、八年级和九年级时，我热爱学习。

sentences.en: I loved it.
sentences.zh: 我热爱它。

sentences.en: I did all the homework.
sentences.zh: 我完成了所有的家庭作业。

sentences.en: I did all the reading.
sentences.zh: 我完成了所有的阅读。

sentences.en: I was very motivated by that.
sentences.zh: 我对此非常有动力。

sentences.en: I think my downfall was boys, Jack.
sentences.zh: 我想我的失败是因为男生，Jack。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Preaching to the choir.
sentences.zh: 我也深有同感。

sentences.en: Year 10, I was like, oh, there's some boys over there.
sentences.zh: 十年级的时候，我就想，哦，那边有几个男生。

sentences.en: And I just did less.
sentences.zh: 然后我就做得少了。

sentences.en: But I wish I'd known it's cool to learn.
sentences.zh: 但我真希望当时就知道学习是很酷的。

sentences.en: It's safe for you to be, I don't know, the bod.
sentences.zh: 你可以安全地做那个，我不知道，那个书呆子。

sentences.en: The clever one.
sentences.zh: 那个聪明的人。

sentences.en: And you can do both things.
sentences.zh: 你可以两件事都做。

sentences.en: You can be snogging boys and still learning and still achieving.
sentences.zh: 你可以和男生谈恋爱，同时还能学习并取得成就。

sentences.en: And that's OK.
sentences.zh: 这没关系。

sentences.en: But actually, the fact that it's making a difference and becoming like a regular, you know, a stalwart in psychology is amazing.
sentences.zh: 但事实上，它正在产生影响，并成为心理学领域的一个常态，这太棒了。

sentences.en: So thank you to you, Jack.
sentences.zh: 所以谢谢你，杰克。

sentences.en: And thank you to my listeners and watchers as well.
sentences.zh: 也谢谢我的听众和观众。

sentences.en: Like, what a treat.
sentences.zh: 这真是一种享受。

sentences.en: I think that's a good attestment to something I know I did in my undergrad, as I'm sure many
sentences.zh: 我认为这很好地证明了我本科时做过的一件事，我相信今天收听的很多人

sentences.en: people listening today will have that kind of panic over grades, assignments, classification.
sentences.zh: 都会对成绩、作业、学位等级感到恐慌。

sentences.en: I really had to do a bit of reflection and think, what is it I want to do?
sentences.zh: 我真的需要反思一下，思考我到底想做什么？

sentences.en: Similar to what companies will have.
sentences.zh: 和公司的情况类似。

sentences.en: I gave myself a little mission statement, which I kind of just alluded to.
sentences.zh: 我给自己定了一个小小的使命宣言，也就是我刚才提到的。

sentences.en: I wanted to help people.
sentences.zh: 我想帮助别人。

sentences.en: In my head, or especially in year one or year two in my undergrad, in my head, that was simply, if I want to help people, I've got to be a clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 在我的脑海里，特别是在本科一年级或二年级时，那很简单，如果我想帮助别人，我就必须成为一名临床心理学家。

sentences.en: I've got to do steps A, B, and C.
sentences.zh: 我必须完成A、B、C步骤。

sentences.en: And that was it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: I had a very limited lens.
sentences.zh: 我的视角非常有限。

sentences.en: And as I was panicking about grades, I was trying to come up with a plan B.
sentences.zh: 当我为成绩感到恐慌时，我试图想出一个B计划。

sentences.en: And I thought, well, actually, if I want to help people, there are many different ways I can help people.
sentences.zh: 我想，其实如果我想帮助别人，有很多不同的方式。

sentences.en: It doesn't have to be solely as a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 不一定非要成为心理学家。

sentences.en: And then that's where I've tried to diversify what I do.
sentences.zh: 这就是我尝试多元化发展的原因。

sentences.en: So even my role now, so my job title is regional support officer.
sentences.zh: 即使是我现在的角色，我的职位是区域支持官。

sentences.en: So I work as a regional manager, supporting services and teaMs.
sentences.zh: 我作为区域经理，支持服务和团队。

sentences.en: So on paper, you know, it's not very psychological.
sentences.zh: 所以从纸面上看，这看起来不太像心理学工作。

sentences.en: It's not very supportive.
sentences.zh: 看起来不太像支持性工作。

sentences.en: But it's something that I kind of bring to the role.
sentences.zh: 但这是我带入这个角色的东西。

sentences.en: So I do have staff members ringing me in times of crisis, or if they need emotional, support, I've delivered interventions to the people we support as well.
sentences.zh: 所以确实有员工在危机时刻打电话给我，或者如果他们需要情感支持，我也为我们支持的人提供过干预。

sentences.en: I've put things in place around training and inductions, again, to support people.
sentences.zh: 我还在培训和入职方面落实了一些措施，同样是为了支持他人。

sentences.en: So I'm still fulfilling my mission statement of wanting to help in a slightly untraditional way.
sentences.zh: 所以我仍然以一种非传统的方式履行着我想帮助他人的使命。

sentences.en: But even yourself, like, say, with the podcast, that's not a traditional duty one would expect of a clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 即使是你自己，比如做播客，这也不是人们对临床心理学家的传统职责期望。

sentences.en: But there are ways that you can help people in an untraditional sense, you know, your community, your listeners, people getting that support they need from a relevant source.
sentences.zh: 但你可以以非传统的方式帮助别人，比如你的社区、你的听众，人们从相关渠道获得了他们需要的支持。

sentences.en: It's accessible.
sentences.zh: 它是可获取的。

sentences.en: It's not behind, you know, a paywall.
sentences.zh: 它没有被付费墙挡住。

sentences.en: If you've got Spotify or, you know, Apple Music and any good, you know, podcast platform,
sentences.zh: 如果你有Spotify，或者苹果音乐，或者任何好的播客平台，

sentences.en: they can access, you know, guidance from leading professionals, which, again, is a creative way in job crafting, really.
sentences.zh: 他们就可以获取领先专业人士的指导，这确实是工作重塑的一种创造性方式。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: And I will tell you off camera what the plans are for the 200 episode series, but it's very excited.
sentences.zh: 我会私下告诉你200期系列节目的计划，非常令人兴奋。

sentences.en: So, yeah, watch this space, listeners and viewers, and I will tell you more as soon as I can.
sentences.zh: 所以，敬请期待，听众和观众们，我一能说就会告诉你们更多。

sentences.en: Jack, is there anything we haven't covered that you think would be really useful for us to do before we finish together today?
sentences.zh: 杰克，今天结束之前，还有什么我们没涵盖到，你觉得对大家非常有用的吗？

sentences.en: I think one of the things I would like to say to anyone listening and watching today is don't be afraid to get creative with your experience and your journey.
sentences.zh: 我想对今天所有收听和观看的人说的一点是，不要害怕在你的经历和旅程中发挥创造力。

sentences.en: It's taken me many years to end up where I am, and that was just making the most out of opportunities.
sentences.zh: 我花了很多年才走到今天，这只是充分利用了每一个机会。

sentences.en: And some of the kind of positions that I know a lot of students will covet for around the trainee PWPs, APs, Dclins are very competitive.
sentences.zh: 我知道很多学生梦寐以求的职位，比如心理健康从业者（PWP）、助理心理学家（AP）、临床心理学博士（DClin）竞争非常激烈。

sentences.en: So, not to get, you know, disheartened with that.
sentences.zh: 所以，不要因此感到灰心。

sentences.en: Make the most out of what you do have, whether it's, you know, a psychology-related role or not.
sentences.zh: 充分利用你所拥有的，无论它是否与心理学相关。

sentences.en: My role is not psychology-related whatsoever on paper, but it's my approach.
sentences.zh: 我的角色在纸面上完全与心理学无关，但这是我的方法。

sentences.en: I approach things with evidence-based.
sentences.zh: 我以循证的方式处理事情。

sentences.en: I approach things with theory.
sentences.zh: 我以理论为基础处理事情。

sentences.en: So, I definitely want to encourage people with that, engage in that kind of job crafting behaviours, try and find something that fulfills your needs and the needs of your employer.
sentences.zh: 所以，我绝对想鼓励大家尝试这种“工作塑造”行为，试着去寻找能满足你自身需求以及雇主需求的工作内容。

sentences.en: And there will be ways that you can kind of do the two, you know, together and really reflect on what it is you want to do, what you want to achieve.
sentences.zh: 你可以找到某种方式将两者结合起来，真正反思自己想要做什么，想要达成什么目标。

sentences.en: And just going back on the experiences as well, think of the ways you can market them to employers when you are going for Dclins or the AP roles.
sentences.zh: 回顾过往经历时，也要思考当你申请临床心理学博士（DClin）或助理心理学家（AP）职位时，如何向雇主推销这些经历。

sentences.en: I often find, because I've conducted a lot of interviews in this current role, sometimes
sentences.zh: 我经常发现，因为我在目前这个职位上进行过很多面试，有时

sentences.en: you need to be quite clear with how your marketing skills, similar to how we would write essays,
sentences.zh: 你需要非常清楚如何推销自己的技能，就像我们写论文一样，

sentences.en: you know, once you've made a point, relate it back to the question, relate it to how that's going to benefit your employer.
sentences.zh: 你知道，一旦你提出了一个观点，就要把它与问题联系起来，并说明它将如何使你的雇主受益。

sentences.en: If it's, you know, a time you've overcome something, tell them, that means I can keep cool, calm and collected in a, you know, a situation.
sentences.zh: 如果这是你克服困难的一次经历，告诉他们，这意味着我在某种情况下能够保持冷静、沉着。

sentences.en: Let people really know what those skills are, because they are all transferable, as cliche as it sounds.
sentences.zh: 让人们真正了解这些技能是什么，因为尽管听起来很老套，但它们都是可迁移的。

sentences.en: Sometimes you need to connect the dots for whoever you're interviewing, rather than make your own interpretation.
sentences.zh: 有时你需要为你面试的人把这些点串联起来，而不是让他们自己去解读。

sentences.en: Yeah, amazing.
sentences.zh: 是的，太棒了。

sentences.en: And I think I would really encourage people to not think about a timeline, you know, so absolutely, if you've done your psychology undergrad, and, you know, you're
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我真的会鼓励大家不要去考虑时间表，你知道，所以绝对的，如果你已经完成了心理学本科，并且，你知道，你

sentences.en: like, Oh, I'm 21.
sentences.zh: 觉得，哦，我21岁了。

sentences.en: Now I need to be an assistant psychologist by the time I'm 22.
sentences.zh: 现在我需要在22岁之前成为一名助理心理学家。

sentences.en: I will, I would say, that's probably unrealistic.
sentences.zh: 我会说，这可能是不现实的。

sentences.en: That's probably, you know, putting more pressure on yourself than you need.
sentences.zh: 这可能，你知道，给自己施加了不必要的压力。

sentences.en: Because actually, people who are often getting shortlisted for
sentences.zh: 因为实际上，那些经常被列入

sentences.zh: AP面试名单的人，可能已经有了几年的相关工作经验，他们可能已经获得了硕士学位，你知道。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, take that pressure off.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，卸下那些压力吧。

sentences.en: And don't assume just because you've got a psych undergrad that you can go on straight into an AP role, because
sentences.zh: 不要以为仅仅因为你有了心理学本科学位，就可以直接进入AP职位，因为

sentences.en: it's not impossible, but it's very uncommon, even when I was graduating.
sentences.zh: 这并非不可能，但非常罕见，即使在我毕业的时候也是如此。

sentences.en: And yes, do still apply for the jobs, because you might get lucky.
sentences.zh: 当然，还是要申请这些工作，因为你可能会很幸运。

sentences.en: But please know, speaking from someone who's quite seasoned in this now, it, you know, you really will be a better assistant, if that's
sentences.zh: 但请知道，作为一个现在对此相当有经验的人，如果这是

sentences.en: the route you're wanting to go down, for having done those relevant experience roles.
sentences.zh: 你想要走的路线，你确实会因为拥有那些相关的工作经验而成为一名更好的助理。

sentences.en: So by the time I was an AP, I had worked as a student support assistant at university, I had worked as a home carer, I had worked in a call centre, as we've already covered today.
sentences.zh: 所以在我成为AP之前，我曾在大学做过学生支持助理，做过家庭护理员，做过呼叫中心客服，正如我们今天已经提到的那样。

sentences.en: I then went and worked for
sentences.zh: 然后我去

sentences.en: Milton Keynes Council for two and a half years, in a rehab assistant role for physically disabled adults living in the community.
sentences.zh: 米尔顿凯恩斯议会工作了两年半，担任社区内肢体残疾成年人的康复助理。

sentences.en: I then did some honorary AP work using my annual leave for
sentences.zh: 然后我利用年假做了一些无薪的AP工作，

sentences.en: 10 days, across a couple of months, I did that.
sentences.zh: 在几个月内做了10天，我做了那个。

sentences.en: And then I got a paid AP role.
sentences.zh: 然后我获得了一份有薪的AP职位。

sentences.en: So that is not straight out of university.
sentences.zh: 所以那并不是一毕业就直接得到的。

sentences.en: I also went travelling around the world for six months, and saved up to do that beforehand.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，我还环游世界了六个月，并为此存了钱。

sentences.en: So yeah, really do take the timeline off this, I would say.
sentences.zh: 所以是的，真的要把时间表从这件事上拿掉，我会这么说。

sentences.en: Yeah, 100%.
sentences.zh: 是的，百分之百。

sentences.en: My timeline has not been cohesive to follow.
sentences.zh: 我的时间表并不连贯，无法遵循。

sentences.en: And I was trying to map it out mentally for this journey.
sentences.zh: 我曾试图在脑海中为这段旅程绘制蓝图。

sentences.en: I forgot I did this small stint in the south of France back in 2013.
sentences.zh: 我忘了我还在2013年去法国南部做过那段小工作。

sentences.en: What do you think about this?
sentences.zh: 你对此怎么看？

sentences.en: I think I think about this, just enjoy the journey, not the destination, as cliche as it is.
sentences.zh: 我想，我对此的想法是，享受旅程，而不是终点，尽管这很老套。

sentences.en: And enjoy the experience.
sentences.zh: 享受这段经历。

sentences.en: And just think of it as experience, gaining diverse experience.
sentences.zh: 把它看作是一种经历，获得多样化的经验。

sentences.en: That's something I like as an employee, when I'm doing interviews with people, for our support roles is what can they bring to the team?
sentences.zh: 作为雇主，当我在面试支持岗位的人时，我喜欢的一点是：他们能给团队带来什么？

sentences.en: What is suitable for us?
sentences.zh: 什么对我们来说是合适的？

sentences.en: What experience have we got working with people?
sentences.zh: 我们有什么与人打交道的经验？

sentences.en: And whether it's, you know, people with mental health issues, drug and alcohol and substance, learning difficulties, it's still a supportive role helping people.
sentences.zh: 无论是与心理健康问题、药物和酒精及物质滥用、学习障碍的人群打交道，这仍然是一个帮助人们的支持性角色。

sentences.en: It just might not be the way, as a student, you've planned it as a perfect linear fashion.
sentences.zh: 它可能不像你作为学生时规划的那样完美线性。

sentences.en: But it is all relevant.
sentences.zh: 但这一切都是相关的。

sentences.en: Just enjoy that process.
sentences.zh: 享受这个过程吧。

sentences.en: Make those connections as well, you know, your own kind of career network as well.
sentences.zh: 也要建立那些联系，你知道，建立你自己的职业网络。

sentences.en: And slowly it does kind of get out there to where you want.
sentences.zh: 慢慢地，它确实会把你带到你想去的地方。

sentences.en: And get your reflective journal out, you know, write about this stuff.
sentences.zh: 拿出你的反思日记，你知道，写下这些东西。

sentences.en: Really think about shaping, growing, you know, looking at your vulnerabilities, looking at your
sentences.zh: 真正去思考塑造、成长，你知道，审视你的脆弱，审视你的

sentences.en: strengths, really, honestly, start writing, you know, do it either in your phone or natural book or on your computer.
sentences.zh: 优势，真的，诚实地开始写作，你知道，在手机、笔记本或电脑上写都可以。

sentences.en: Start it, do it, keep it up.
sentences.zh: 开始做，坚持做，保持下去。

sentences.en: 100% in both the corporate world and now where I am working kind of third sector, there is a lot around reflection.
sentences.zh: 百分之百，无论是在企业界还是我现在工作的第三部门，反思都是非常重要的。

sentences.en: It's something we encourage with our practitioners and recovery workers, you know, to be aware of their own shortcomings, whether it's more
sentences.zh: 这是我们鼓励从业者和康复工作者去做的事情，你知道，要意识到他们自己的缺点，无论是

sentences.en: professional weaknesses around systems in case notes, or whether it's something in the therapeutic work they do.
sentences.zh: 关于系统和病例记录的专业弱点，还是他们在治疗工作中遇到的问题。

sentences.en: It's something you've got to be mindful of if you are thinking of working

sentences.en: in mental health and counselling.
sentences.zh: 即使你更多地考虑企业界也是如此。

sentences.en: Even if you're thinking more of a corporate world as well.

sentences.en: So what I do in organisational psychology, again, we have to do a lot of reflection for our biases when it comes to recruitment, selection, job design.
sentences.zh: 所以当你与人打交道，以及解读他人时，总会有反思。

sentences.en: And yeah, thank you again for pitching this episode.
